Container.Name: LibreNMS-Dispatcher
Container.Overview:
Dispatcher service sidecar for an existing LibreNMS container (for example librenms from A75G's repository). The official LibreNMS image does not poll devices on its own: polling and discovery run in at least one separate dispatcher container. This template runs that container from the same official image librenms/librenms with SIDECAR_DISPATCHER=1.
Use the same appdata folder (/data) and the same database settings as your LibreNMS container, and start LibreNMS first. Redis is required (the dispatcher does not start without it), for example the Redis app from Community Apps. With several dispatchers, give each a unique DISPATCHER_NODE_ID and hostname.
Check the result in LibreNMS under Settings - Pollers: the dispatcher shows up with its node ID and hostname.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: librenms poller dispatcher sidecar snmp monitoring
Container.Requires: A running LibreNMS container (for example librenms from A75G's repository), its MariaDB/MySQL database, and a Redis server.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The SAME folder your LibreNMS container uses for /data (config, RRD files, logs).

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Database host or IP, as in your LibreNMS container. It must be reachable from this container's network.

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Database name, as in your LibreNMS container.

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: Database user, as in your LibreNMS container.

Config.Name: DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password, as in your LibreNMS container.

Config.Name: DB_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for the database at start.

Config.Name: DISPATCHER_NODE_ID
Config.Description: Unique ID of this dispatcher. Use a different one for each dispatcher container.

Config.Name: REDIS_HOST
Config.Description: Redis host or IP. Required: the dispatcher does not start without Redis. Set the same Redis on the LibreNMS container.

Config.Name: DISPATCHER_ARGS
Config.Description: Extra arguments for librenms-service.py, e.g. -v for verbose logs.

Config.Name: MEMORY_LIMIT
Config.Description: PHP memory limit for the poller processes.

Config.Name: SIDECAR_DISPATCHER
Config.Description: Runs this container as dispatcher. Must stay 1.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID, same as in your LibreNMS container.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID, same as in your LibreNMS container.
